note: North Macedonia: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 90 days in any 180 (Georgia 90). Everyone else needs a visa (holders of Schengen visas, or of Canadian, UK or US multiple-entry visas in 2026, may enter for 15 days; Belarusians with a tourist voucher: not modelled). Read from Wikipedia's copy. Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade's own answer, country by country, to 'Do you need a visa?': every passport held as free is 'Not needed' but Hong Kong's and Macao's, which it doesn't list, and every one held as a visa is 'Needed'; it gives a length only for Taiwan (90 days in any 180, to 31 March 2030). The lengths, Hong Kong and Macao stand on Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade of North Macedonia, Do you need a visa? (its 'Visa for foreign citizens' answer for each of 194 countries, read through the page's own Livewire calls changeRegion and changeHardcodedRecord)
sources.said: [Algeria] Visa for foreign citizens: Needed ... [Georgia] Visa for foreign citizens: Not needed ... [Taiwan] Visa for foreign citizens: Not needed Notes: - Visa is not required for holders of diplomatic and special passports; - Visa is not required for entry and short term stay, for holders of Taiwanese passports containing the identity card number, for stay up to 90 days in any 180 days period. The Decision is in force until 31.03.2030

sources.title: MFA North Macedonia, Visa requirements for entering the Republic of North Macedonia
sources.said: Nationals of EU Member States and signatories of the Schengen Agreement DO NOT need a visa to enter the Republic of North Macedonia (and are eligible to enter the Republic of North Macedonia with a valid national identity card) ... Third-country nationals with multiple-entry Schengen visa (type C) valid for at least 5 (five) days beyond the intended stay in the Republic of North Macedonia may stay no longer than 15 (fifteen) days upon every entry ... as long as the total length of stay does not exceed 90 days in any 180-day period.
